messages.subject: Project Cedar — first draft Licence Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Deepa, Oliver,

Please find attached the first draft of the Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement for Project Cedar, together with its schedules. It follows the agreed term sheet: exclusive licence in the cosmetics field, £1.75m upfront, milestones to £4.25m, 6% / 4% royalty, with the minimum annual royalties in Schedule 4.

We've left the rate at 6% per the term sheet; we understand your client may want to revisit it. We look forward to your mark-up.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
